note: Cases for check 3 (blind re-implementation) and check 4 (snow model horizons). Coordinates are sample points near each named place, not surveyed positions. Times are Pacific (America/Los_Angeles).

patch.points: point (i, j) for i, j = 0..n-1 (i east, j south, row-major j then i): north_m = (n // 2 - j) * spacing_m, east_m = (i - n // 2) * spacing_m; lat = lat0 + north_m / 111320; lon = lon0 + east_m / (111320 * cos(radians(lat0)))
